t: The Internet as Database and the Evolution of Search
s: The traditional web crawl-and-index model is dead due to faceted search traps and LLM spam. The internet is now the database, necessitating adaptable websites for AI training and real-time data access.
sub: Internet as a cloud-based key/value database with URLs as keys.
Challenges of faceted search creating spider-traps and LLMs enabling content spam.
Shift towards trusted brand domains for content safety and creative non-incumbents needing new strategies.
Need for websites to be 'in shape' for constant crawling for AI training and drill-down details.
AI development philosophy: pragmatic, iterative (Ship of Theseus), and user-centric (Mr. Meeskeeks analogy).
